title: Options After Hitting Into a Red Penalty Area
question: Your ball lands in a red penalty area. Which of the following relief options is available for a red penalty area but not for a yellow penalty area?

choices.text: Play the ball as it lies, if possible.
Drop a ball within two club-lengths of where it last crossed into the area, for one penalty stroke.
Replay the shot from your previous spot, for one penalty stroke.
Drop anywhere on the course for one penalty stroke.

explanation: Only red penalty areas allow the option to drop a ball within two club-lengths of where it last crossed into the area, with a one-stroke penalty. This option is not allowed for yellow penalty areas.

juniorVersion.title: What Can You Do When Your Ball Goes Into a Red Penalty Area?
juniorVersion.question: Your ball goes into a red penalty area, like a pond or puddle with red lines. What special thing can you do with a red penalty area, but not a yellow one?

choices.text: Try to hit the ball from where it landed, if you can.
Drop your ball within two club-lengths from where it crossed the edge, and take one penalty shot.
Go back and play from where you last hit, with one penalty shot.
Drop the ball anywhere you want on the course for one penalty shot.

juniorVersion.explanation: With a red penalty area, you are allowed to drop your ball within two club-lengths of where it entered the area, and then you add one penalty stroke. You can't do this with a yellow penalty area.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: A place on the golf course marked by yellow or red lines, like a pond, puddle, or stream, where special rules are used.
The length of your longest club, usually your driver.
An extra shot added to your score because of a rule.

juniorVersion.teachingTip: Use coloured ropes or chalk to show red and yellow areas on a practice field, so kids can see the difference and practise the drops.
likelyMisconceptions: Some juniors might think the two club-length drop is allowed for yellow penalty areas, but it is only for red penalty areas.
Kids might think they can drop the ball anywhere for a penalty stroke, but there are special rules for where you drop.
